constraints: jax.numpy.isposinf(x) returns a boolean array indicating whether each element of input is positive infinity.
jax.numpy.isneginf(x) returns a boolean array indicating whether each element of input is negative infinity.
jax.numpy.isfinite(x) returns a boolean array indicating whether each element of input is finite (not NaN and not infinity).
jax.numpy.isnan(x) returns a boolean array indicating whether each element of input is not a number (NaN).

output.description: A boolean array of same shape as ``x`` containing ``True`` where ``x`` is ``inf`` or ``-inf``, and ``False`` otherwise.
